We've got used oil drums, vehicle batteries, expired medical cold packs, and empty compressed-air cylinders awaiting disposition. Environmental, maintenance, medical-logistics, and transportation reps -- please report your confirmed updates so I can record them in the review record and get the disposition plan signed.
